description: Master switch and guard rails for the MCP server that lets Claude Code and Codex read and change data on this site.

fields.description: Nothing reaches the site through MCP while this is off.
fields.label: Enable MCP Access

fields.description: Blocks every tool that writes, no matter what is ticked below. Turn off only while you intend Claude to change data.
fields.label: Read Only Mode

fields.description: Set by Allow Writes For. Read Only Mode switches itself back on at this time.
fields.label: Writes Allowed Until

fields.description: The user Claude Code or Codex acts as. Its own Frappe roles still bound what MCP can reach, so a purpose-made user with only the roles it needs is safer than Administrator. Use Generate API Keys above to issue its credentials.
fields.label: MCP User

fields.description: Clients that send Authorization: token key:secret, including the local stdio bridge.
fields.label: Allow API Key Sign-In

fields.description: Each person signs in with their own Frappe account from Claude Code, Codex, Claude Desktop or claude.ai, and approves access on this site. Turning this on publishes the OAuth discovery documents and lets MCP clients register themselves.
fields.label: Allow OAuth Sign-In

fields.description: Read documents, schemas and reports.
fields.label: Allow Read

fields.description: Create and update documents.
fields.label: Allow Write

fields.description: Bulk insert and update rows supplied as JSON or CSV.
fields.label: Allow Data Import

fields.description: Run app patch modules listed in patches.txt.
fields.label: Allow Running Patches

fields.description: Read-only SELECT statements only; writes are rejected by the SQL guard.
fields.label: Allow SQL Query

fields.description: Clear cache, reload doctypes, rebuild a document's links, enqueue scheduled jobs.
fields.label: Allow Admin Actions

fields.description: Runs a Server Script sandbox snippet. The widest door in this list — leave it off unless you are actively repairing data.
fields.label: Allow Server Script

fields.description: When ticked, only the doctypes listed below can be touched.
fields.label: Restrict To Listed Doctypes

fields.description: Always refused, even when listed as allowed.
fields.label: Blocked Doctypes

fields.description: The API key's user must hold one of these roles. Empty means System Manager only.
fields.label: Allowed Roles

fields.description: One IP or CIDR range per line. Empty means any address.
fields.label: Allowed IP Addresses

fields.description: Values of these fields are replaced with ••• in everything MCP returns, and filtering, sorting or querying on them is refused, so they never reach the AI model. Password fields are never returned in any case.
fields.label: Masked Fields

fields.description: Every write runs as a dry run unless the caller explicitly passes dry_run=false.
fields.label: Default To Dry Run

fields.description: Ceiling on rows returned by a single read.
fields.label: Max Rows Per Read

fields.description: Ceiling on documents changed by a single bulk update or import.
fields.label: Max Documents Per Write Batch

fields.description: 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Max Requests Per Hour

fields.description: Writes a MCP Bridge Log row for every call, including the ones that were refused.
fields.label: Log Requests

fields.description: Logs older than this are cleared by the daily scheduler. 0 keeps them forever.
fields.label: Log Retention (Days)

name: MCP Bridge Settings
